purpose: What a working gold-plating bench must reason about and decide before any tank is filled or any job is quoted: which gold family (alkaline cyanide, neutral, acid hard, sulfite cyanide-free, electroless/immersion) fills each bath role (strike, build, color) over which support-bath stack, matched to the verified substrate class, the promised wear class, the color target, the piece geometry and the shop's lawful capability envelope, with every operating specific deferred to the chosen commercial product's technical data sheet and every claim flagged against its regulated class.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
the setting is a small working gold-plating bench serving retail customers and trade accounts in single pieces and small lots, not a high-speed reel-to-reel plant, though the same family logic scales

all plating chemistry is purchased commercial product used per its technical data sheet and safety data sheet; nothing in this KB is a formulation instruction and no bath is ever compounded from raw chemicals

facts drawn from the in-repo process corpus keep their corpus tags; anything the corpus marks unknown stays unknown here, and product-specific operating windows belong to the supplier's technical data sheet, never to this KB

wherever cyanide-bearing and acid process chemistry coexist on a line they are physically and procedurally segregated - separate zones, separate drains, separate spill response - and formal training plus the jurisdiction's workplace and hazmat rules govern all hazardous work
exclusions: keeping a chosen bath inside its window - what gold concentration, pH, temperature, agitation and additive balance each do to the deposit, drift signatures, analysis method classes, replenishment discipline and the running bath log - is the sibling analysis-and-replenishment KB's territory; this KB only opens the log header when a selection is committed

why baths die and what to do about it - drag-in and drag-out control, metallic and organic contamination signatures, filtration and carbon treatment, bath aging, regenerate-versus-replace economics and gold recovery from spent solutions - is the sibling contamination-and-lifecycle KB's territory; this KB only prices bath mortality into the selection

substrate identification, piece triage and the chemical prep line belong to the surface-preparation specialist; this KB consumes the verified substrate class its triage hands over and never re-runs the identification

delivering the deposit - current density and time arithmetic, rectifier setup, fixturing and racking, layer execution and thickness verification - belongs to the process-execution and quality specialists; this KB chooses systems, not settings

no numeric setpoint is stated as universal fact: temperatures, pH values, concentrations and current densities appear only as mechanisms or as published handbook-class ranges, and the technical data sheet of the specific commercial product governs every real setpoint

no DIY bath formulation from raw chemicals and no improvised safety procedure: cyanide content here is safety-class guidance pointing to formal training and jurisdiction rules, never an operating instruction
PVD and other dry-coating routes are named only as an out-of-scope alternative class for referral; their selection and execution are not covered

regulated marking and health terms - gold plated, vermeil, gold filled, rolled gold, nickel-release limits, food-contact status - are obligation classes with verify-your-jurisdiction pointers, never asserted numeric thresholds, and nothing here is personalized legal or medical advice

competency_questions.question: A brass pendant needs a rich yellow, daily-wear finish - which gold system do I run for each layer, and what evidence backs the choice?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: JOB_SELECTION_BRIEF turns the order into a selection brief, FAMILY_TRADEOFF_BENCHMARK screens the families against it, and WEAR_CLASS_MATCHING maps daily wear to a deposit class the line can actually produce

competency_questions.question: Why do serious gold lines split into strike, build and color baths instead of one tank, and when may a role be skipped or merged?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BATH_ROLE_ARCHITECTURE names the three roles and their division of labor; GOLD_STRIKE_DOCTRINE states the displacement mechanism the strike suppresses, the live-entry rule, and the narrow cases where the main bath doubles as strike

competency_questions.question: What does the alkaline cyanide family buy me that nothing else does, and what does keeping it cost the shop?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ALKALINE_CYANIDE_FAMILY states the reference-chemistry strengths (complex stability, efficiency, ductile 24k deposit, strike power) and SHOP_CAPABILITY_GATE states the licensing, segregation, monitoring and training obligation classes that price it

competency_questions.question: When is acid hard gold or a neutral gold the right call, and what disqualifies them for a given job?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ACID_HARD_GOLD_FAMILY gives the hardened-deposit case and its brittleness and throw limits, NEUTRAL_MILD_GOLD_CLASS positions the near-neutral class, and DUCTILITY_FORMING_CONSTRAINT states the form-first disqualifier

competency_questions.question: Can I run a genuinely cyanide-free gold line, and what do I honestly give up by doing so?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SULFITE_CN_FREE_FAMILY states what the weak complex costs (bath life, strike power, softness) and what it removes (the acute-lethality tier), and FAMILY_TRADEOFF_BENCHMARK places those trades against the cyanide families without flattering either side

competency_questions.question: What can immersion and electroless gold actually deliver, and when is selling it as the finish dishonest?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ELECTROLESS_IMMERSION_CLASS states the self-limiting ceiling and the family's real roles, and WEAR_CLASS_MATCHING shows why a displacement flash can never carry a wear-class promise

competency_questions.question: What shifts a gold deposit toward rose, yellow or green, and where do the actual hue recipes live?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: COLOR_KARAT_ALLOY_MECHANISM names the alloying directions (copper toward rose, silver toward green, nickel and palladium toward pale) as mechanism and locates exact recipes in supplier products, and COLOR_BATH_SELECTION turns a hue target into a bath choice

competency_questions.question: Which support baths belong under this job's gold - nickel, palladium, copper - and what compliance flags does each raise?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SUPPORT_BATH_CLASSES describes each class and its job in the stack, and COMPLIANCE_CLAIM_FLAGS attaches the nickel-release class and its verify-jurisdiction pointer wherever nickel appears under skin-contact gold

competency_questions.question: The piece is stainless, zinc die-cast or silver - how does the substrate class change which gold system and stack I may run?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SUBSTRATE_STACK_MATCHING maps each substrate class to its mandatory barriers and compatible families, and GOLD_STRIKE_DOCTRINE explains why displacement-prone substrates never enter a gold bath without strike and live entry

competency_questions.question: The customer wants the ring resized or bent after plating - which deposit families survive that, and which are disqualified outright?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DUCTILITY_FORMING_CONSTRAINT ranks the deposit classes by published ductility behavior, names form-first as the default flow, and states the one narrow soft-gold allowance with its wear cost

competency_questions.question: How big should each bath be, and why is one large tank of everything the wrong answer?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BATH_SIZING_INVENTORY prices gold locked in solution and bath mortality into tank sizing, and BATH_ROLE_ARCHITECTURE explains why the strike stays small and sacrificial

competency_questions.question: A new supplier system looks good on paper - what must happen before a customer piece ever enters it?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: NEW_PRODUCT_QUALIFICATION requires documentation on file, a capability-envelope check and a scrap or witness-coupon trial before commitment, and TDS_GOVERNANCE states why a product without a technical data sheet never gets a tank

competency_questions.question: Where do my operating setpoints actually come from, and what may I never invent or copy from memory?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TDS_GOVERNANCE fixes the technical data sheet of the specific product as the owner of every setpoint, and SELECTION_DECISION_RECORD shows the record citing product and TDS rather than numbers stated as universal fact

competency_questions.question: When is the honest answer 'this is not a wet-plating job at all', and what does the bench do then?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PVD_OUTSCOPE_BOUNDARY names the job patterns that belong to the dry-coating class and the referral behavior, and JOB_SELECTION_BRIEF shows the route-out question asked before quoting

glossary.definition: A small, deliberately gold-lean, high-adhesion first gold bath entered with current already flowing; it suppresses the spontaneous displacement deposit that ruins adhesion on less-noble metals and sacrificially absorbs drag-in contamination so the expensive build bath stays clean.

The main thickness-building gold electrolyte of a line; it carries most of the shop's dissolved gold inventory and is protected by the strike, and its family choice (cyanide, acid hard, sulfite) sets the deposit's hardness, purity and color body.

A lean, usually alloyed final-coat bath that exists to spend as little gold as possible while setting the visible hue; alloy metals co-deposited with the gold shift the tone, so its whole control problem is hue stability, not thickness.

The historical reference gold chemistry: gold held as the extremely stable aurocyanide complex in a strongly alkaline bath, depositing near-pure ductile 24-karat soft gold at high cathode efficiency; published chemistry puts a hard alkalinity floor under every free-cyanide solution because lethal hydrogen cyanide forms below it.

Gold plated from a mildly acidic citrate-buffered bath with small cobalt or nickel additions that refine the grain and roughly double-to-triple the deposit hardness against soft gold per the published class ranges; bright as plated, wear-resistant, and brittle - the connector and hard-wear jewelry chemistry.

Gold held as a comparatively weak gold-sulfite complex in an alkaline bath; it removes the acute cyanide hazard tier entirely but is thermodynamically prone to spontaneous decomposition, so it trades bath life, strike power and deposit hardness for safety and residential compatibility.

Gold deposited without current by the workpiece's own surface metal dissolving in exchange; the reaction self-terminates once gold covers the surface, capping thickness at a published flash-class ceiling around a tenth of a micron - a mechanism, not a settings choice.

A bath family's ability to deposit into recesses and low-current-density zones relative to exposed surfaces; alkaline cyanide throws well, diffusion-limited acid hard gold throws poorly, and electroless deposition ignores current distribution entirely.

The supplier document for a specific commercial bath product that owns its make-up, operating window, replenishment and compatibility statements; on this bench it is the only legitimate source of setpoints, and a product without one does not get a tank.

A regulated marking class for gold over sterling silver at jurisdiction-defined thickness and karat conditions; on this bench it is a claim flag that forces a silver substrate and a compliance check, never a number recited from memory - verify the current rules where the piece sells.

nodes.definition: Translate each incoming job into the one-page brief every selection decision hangs from: the color and karat appearance the customer expects (against a retained reference, not an adjective), the wear class the piece will live in (flash refresh, daily-wear micron, heavy-wear), the verified substrate class handed over by prep triage, the geometry class (open surfaces versus recesses, hollows, filigree), lot size and deadline, any claim words already used in the sale (vermeil, gold plated, hypoallergenic), and whether the piece will be formed or resized after plating. The brief exists because most bad bath choices are actually missing questions: a rose hue nobody wrote down, a piercing post nobody flagged, a resize request that surfaces after a brittle deposit is on the ring.

included: color/karat target capture against a reference
wear class and post-plate forming intent
substrate class as received from prep triage
claim words and compliance flags
geometry, lot size and deadline
excluded: re-identifying the substrate (prep's verdict is consumed, not repeated)
pricing and quoting (business specialist)
any bath parameter

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a run of returned jobs whose failure traces to a question the brief template never asked

pros.claim: A written brief converts vague orders into checkable selection inputs before money and gold are committed
pros.example: the words 'gold like grandma's ring' become a hue matched against the shop's retained color plaques, and the mismatch conversation happens before the tank, not at pickup

cons.claim: Brief-taking costs front-desk minutes on jobs that look trivial, and over-templated briefs get pencil-whipped
cons.example: a batch of twenty flash refreshes gets one lazy shared brief, and the single piercing-post pair hidden in the lot misses its nickel-release flag

failure_modes: wear expectations left implicit, so a flash job is silently promised heavy-wear life
post-plate forming intent never asked, disqualifying the chosen deposit only after it cracks
the brief substitutes the customer's metal claim for prep's verified substrate class
acceptance_tests: every job entering selection has a brief naming color target with reference, wear class, verified substrate class, geometry class, claim flags, forming intent and deadline, and no selection debate proceeds on a field left blank
revisit_triggers: a finished job bounces back with an expectation the brief never captured
the trade book adds a job type (piercing goods, hollow ware) the brief template has no field for

nodes.definition: Fix, before any family is admired, what this shop may lawfully and safely run: whether cyanide-bearing chemistry is licensed, stored, ventilated, monitored and trained for under the jurisdiction's rules; whether cyanide and acid tanks can be physically and procedurally segregated with separate drains and spill response; what ventilation, locked storage and emergency readiness exist as obligation classes. The gate filters the whole selection space - a shop that cannot lawfully hold potassium gold cyanide has no alkaline-cyanide or acid-hard-gold decision to make, whatever the job would prefer - and it treats every product containing a gold-cyanide salt as cyanide-class regardless of how mild its marketing sounds. This is safety-class guidance pointing to formal training and current jurisdiction rules, never an improvised procedure.

included: cyanide licensing and storage status as an obligation class
cyanide/acid segregation feasibility including drains
ventilation, monitoring, training and emergency-readiness classes
the cyanide-class test applied to every candidate product
excluded: writing safety procedure (formal training and the safety specialist own that)
waste treatment mechanics (sibling lifecycle KB and safety specialist)
any numeric exposure or discharge threshold

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a licensing, premises or jurisdiction-rule change, or an incident review showing the register described an envelope the shop did not actually have

pros.claim: Filtering families by the lawful envelope first prevents the worst class of shop error - running chemistry the premises may not hold
pros.example: a home-adjacent studio that wants hard-wear work discovers at the gate, not after purchase, that its lease and jurisdiction exclude cyanide holdings, and plans a cyanide-free line honestly

cons.claim: A conservative gate can under-use a capable shop or push work away that a licensing effort would have won
cons.example: a bench refuses all hard-gold trade work for a year when a feasible licensing, ventilation and training upgrade would have carried it

failure_modes: treating an acid gold bath as 'not really cyanide' because it runs at mild pH, though its gold salt is a cyanide compound
capability assessed from memory instead of the current license, lease and jurisdiction rules
segregation judged on tanks alone while rinse drains still meet
acceptance_tests: a written capability register exists naming license status, segregation layout including drains, ventilation and training classes, with a verify-jurisdiction note and a date
every candidate product is classed cyanide-bearing or not from its safety documentation before it enters any shortlist
revisit_triggers: any change in license, premises, ventilation, staffing or jurisdiction rules
a candidate product's safety data reveals a hazard class the register never considered

nodes.definition: Institutionalize where operating truth lives: the technical data sheet and safety data sheet of the specific commercial product govern make-up, operating window, replenishment chemistry and compatibility, and this KB's family knowledge exists to choose between products, never to substitute for their documents. Selection-level TDS work means collecting the candidate documents before shortlisting, reading them for family confirmation (a 'cyanide-free' label is checked against the actual gold salt), checking compatibility statements against the shop's existing rinses and drains, and refusing any product - however cheap - that arrives without documentation. Handbook-class ranges may be cited as handbook-class ranges when comparing families; they never become the shop's setpoints.

included: TDS/SDS collection before shortlisting
family confirmation from the document, not the label
compatibility reading against the existing line
the no-document-no-tank rule
excluded: running analyses against the TDS window (sibling analysis KB)
reciting or inventing setpoints
supplier commercial negotiation (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a TDS revision, a mislabeled product incident, or a bath failure traced to numbers that came from memory instead of the document

pros.claim: Anchoring every setpoint to the product's own document removes the shop's biggest silent error source - folklore numbers applied to the wrong product
pros.example: two suppliers' sulfite golds carry different stabilizer packages and different windows; the bench that runs supplier B on supplier A's remembered numbers ages the bath and blames the family

cons.claim: Document discipline slows impulse purchases and can feel bureaucratic at a two-person bench
cons.example: a tempting online 'gold solution' at half price is refused for lacking a TDS, and the buyer grumbles until the next forum thread about mystery baths crashing

failure_modes: shortlisting by price and marketing name with documents requested after the order
handbook ranges quietly promoted into operating setpoints
compatibility statements unread, so a new product's rinse stream meets an incompatible drain
acceptance_tests: every tank on the line maps to a named commercial product with TDS and SDS on file, and every setpoint discussion cites the product document rather than a remembered number
revisit_triggers: a supplier revises a TDS mid-life of a bath
an audit finds a tank running on numbers no document supports

nodes.definition: Design the job's gold line as roles before products: a strike role that buys adhesion and shields everything downstream, a build role that owns thickness and carries the gold inventory, and a color role that sets the final hue while spending as little gold as possible. The division of labor is economic and chemical at once - the strike is small, lean and sacrificial so contamination dies there cheaply; the build bath is protected, richer, and chosen for deposit body; the color bath is lean and alloyed because hue needs only a final skin. A jeweler who runs one generous tank for everything is choosing, usually unknowingly, to make that tank simultaneously the contamination buffer, the thickness engine and the hue authority, and it will do all three badly. Roles are fixed per job before any family or product is named, because the role map decides how many tanks the selection must actually fill.

included: the three-role division and its rationale
which roles a given job needs (a flash refresh may need no build role)
role-to-tank mapping before product choice
excluded: executing layer sequences on the rectifier (process specialist)
underplate layer architecture in execution detail (process specialist's layer KB)
specific products (chosen later per role)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: contamination or cost evidence showing the current role division is mis-sized for the shop's actual job mix

pros.claim: Separating roles lets each bath be sized, priced and sacrificed according to its job
pros.example: a half-liter strike absorbs the nickel and copper drag-in from a week of mixed work and is dumped for pennies of gold, while the build bath behind it stays analytically clean

cons.claim: Each role is another tank, heater, lid and maintenance line a small bench must house and mind
cons.example: a one-bench studio doing occasional flash work reasonably runs color-over-strike only, and adding a build tank for one micron job a month would waste locked-up gold

failure_modes: the build bath used as its own strike, so every displacement-prone piece taxes the expensive tank
color chased by thickening the build layer instead of adding a lean color coat
role map drawn after products are bought, forcing the products to define the architecture
acceptance_tests: every selection shows a role map naming which of strike, build and color the job uses and which tank fills each, drawn before any product is named
revisit_triggers: the job mix shifts (heavy builds arriving at a flash-only bench, or vice versa)
a sibling-KB contamination review shows the strike is no longer absorbing what reaches the build bath

nodes.definition: Hold the doctrine that makes gold stick: on any metal less noble than gold, a currentless dip into a gold bath deposits gold by spontaneous displacement as a smutty, non-adherent film, which is why the first gold step is a dedicated strike entered live - current flowing before the work touches solution - in a lean, high-complexant bath formulated to suppress exactly that exchange. The strike also stands guard economically, absorbing drag-in contamination so the build bath does not, which is why it is kept small and dumped without sentiment. The doctrine spans families: alkaline cyanide strikes are the strongest activators, acid strikes serve the acid line, and cyanide-free strikes are honestly weaker on difficult or passivated surfaces - a published trade-off that tightens the prep-to-gold transfer timing rather than excusing a skipped strike. The narrow exceptions (striking in the main bath at elevated current, per some sulfite practice) are supplier-sanctioned cases, not a license to improvise.

included: the displacement mechanism and why live entry defeats it
strike-per-family strength differences as published trade-offs
the sacrificial-buffer economics of a small strike
when the TDS sanctions a main-bath strike condition
excluded: strike bath operating numbers (product TDS)
the prep chain and activation timing itself (surface-prep specialist, though its handoff is honored)
rectifier operation (process specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: defect evidence tying adhesion losses to strike practice, or a supplier TDS that changes what strike condition its build bath sanctions

pros.claim: A standing strike rule converts the most common adhesion catastrophe into a non-event
pros.example: a batch of nickel-plated pieces that sat overnight still enters through the strike live, and the peeling that a dead-entry shortcut would have caused never appears at the customer's ear

cons.claim: The strike is one more gold-bearing tank to hold, log and eventually dump, and small shops resent it on light weeks
cons.example: a bench doing three pendants a week eyes the idle strike tank's locked gold and is tempted to fold strike duty into the build bath permanently

failure_modes: dead entry tolerated on 'just this rush job', producing immersion smut under the whole build
the strike promoted to a de facto build bath because it plates faster at its higher current class
a cyanide-free line assuming cyanide-strike activation power and losing adhesion on passive nickel
acceptance_tests: the selection for any displacement-prone substrate names a strike step and its family, and live entry is written into the handoff to process execution rather than assumed
revisit_triggers: adhesion failures clustering at the strike interface in quality's defect map
a family change (cyanide to cyanide-free) that silently weakened the line's strike power

nodes.definition: Know the reference family every other gold system is benchmarked against: gold held as the extremely stable aurocyanide complex in a strongly alkaline bath, depositing near-pure, ductile, 24-karat-class soft gold at high cathode efficiency, with excess free cyanide stabilizing the complex, dissolving drag-in and suppressing displacement deposits - which is precisely why its strikes activate difficult surfaces better than anything else on the wet line. Published chemistry puts a hard alkalinity floor under every free-cyanide solution because hydrogen cyanide gas forms below it, and that floor, with the licensing, segregation, ventilation, monitoring and training obligation classes around cyanide holdings, is the family's real price. On a licensed line it is the natural home of vermeil-route work over silver, of the most ductile deposits, and of the classic lean color-flash variants; in an unlicensed or residential setting it is the family the bench studies but does not run.

included: complex stability, efficiency and deposit character as published family traits
strike power and contamination tolerance as selection virtues
the safety obligation classes that price the family
its strike, build and color-flash variants as roles
excluded: any operating setpoint (product TDS)
cyanide safety procedure (formal training and the safety specialist)
bath maintenance and carbonate control (sibling analysis KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in the shop's lawful envelope, or published/supplier evidence shifting the family's claimed efficiency, ductility or strike-power class

pros.claim: Highest complex stability and cathode efficiency of any gold family plus the most ductile 24k deposit, making it the forgiving workhorse where it is lawful
pros.example: a silver locket on the vermeil route takes a cyanide strike and soft-gold build that bend with the hinge instead of cracking, a job the hard-gold family would embrittle

cons.claim: The acute-lethality hazard tier and its obligation classes make the family disproportionate for many small decorative shops
cons.example: a bench whose whole book is flash refreshes would carry cyanide licensing, locked storage, monitoring and training overhead to do what a sulfite bath does safely enough

failure_modes: the family selected on chemistry merits with the capability gate checked afterwards
its strike variant assumed interchangeable with acid or sulfite strikes when swapping lines
treating the alkalinity floor as a tunable parameter instead of a safety line
acceptance_tests: any selection naming this family carries the capability register's cyanide clearance alongside it, and the family's traits are cited as published characteristics with setpoints deferred to the product TDS
revisit_triggers: the shop's cyanide clearance changes in either direction
corpus or supplier documentation revises what the family's strike or efficiency class can be claimed to do

nodes.definition: Know the wear-layer family: gold plated from a mildly acidic, citrate-buffered bath in which small cobalt or nickel additions co-deposit and refine the grain, lifting hardness from the soft-gold class to the published hard-gold class (roughly doubling to tripling it) and delivering a bright-as-plated surface - the chemistry that connectors and hard-wear jewelry share. Its selection profile is sharp: it wins rings, bracelets and clasps that must shrug off scratches; it loses wherever the deposit must bend afterwards, because inclusion-hardened gold is brittle by published characteristic; it throws poorly into recesses because the bath runs gold-lean and diffusion-limited; and its gold salt is still a cyanide compound stable only above a published acidity floor, so it lives behind the same capability gate as the alkaline family - a fact 'acid' marketing obscures. Hardener choice tints the deposit (cobalt toward warm, nickel toward pale) and nickel-in-the-gold-layer matters to hypoallergenic claims.

included: hardened-deposit mechanism and its published hardness class
the wear-class jobs it wins and the forming and recess jobs it loses
cyanide-class status of its gold salt as a gate fact
hardener identity as a color and compliance variable
excluded: current density and efficiency management (process and analysis KBs)
any operating window (product TDS)
hue recipe detail (color nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: field evidence on wear or cracking that shifts which jobs the family is matched to, or supplier documentation changing its hardener and compliance story

pros.claim: The only electroplated gold class that carries daily-abrasion wear at jewelry thickness, bright without buffing
pros.example: a signet ring plated in cobalt-hardened gold survives the keys-and-coins pocket that visibly scuffs a soft 24k deposit of equal thickness

cons.claim: Brittleness and poor throw make it a specialist tool that punishes misapplication
cons.example: a filigree pendant comes out with bald recesses, and a resized hard-gold ring shows a crack network at the bend that no replate hides

failure_modes: selected as a 'safer, milder' cyanide alternative because the bath is acid, skipping the gate
specified for a piece that will be sized or bent after plating
chosen for deep-recess geometry where its diffusion-limited throw cannot follow
acceptance_tests: every selection naming this family records the capability clearance, a form-first confirmation from the brief, and a geometry check, and cites hardness and efficiency only as published class ranges
revisit_triggers: quality reports cracking or recess starvation on jobs this family was matched to
a hypoallergenic claim arrives on a job whose hardener is nickel

nodes.definition: Know the cyanide-free family honestly: gold held as a gold-sulfite complex (or mixed sulfite-thiosulfate in near-neutral variants) whose stability constant is orders of magnitude below the aurocyanide complex, so the bath is thermodynamically inclined to decompose - plating gold onto tank walls, heaters and dust unless held in its window with excess ligand and the proprietary stabilizer package that is each commercial product's crown jewel. The deposit is high-purity, fine-grained, low-stress, ductile soft gold with stable 24k color; the family removes the acute cyanide hazard tier entirely, which is why hobby and small-jewelry suppliers sell mainly this class and why it is the default for residential-compatible benches. Its honest price: finite bath life budgeted as a consumable, weaker strike activation demanding tighter prep-to-gold timing, no alloy-color repertoire in the pure baths, mechanical-only agitation (air oxidizes the ligand), and hardened variants that re-import serious hazmat via arsenic-class dopants - a selection trap, not an upgrade.

included: weak-complex instability and its bath-life consequence as published characteristics
safety profile and residential compatibility
soft ductile deposit character and stable pure-gold color
the hardened-variant hazmat trap and supplier lock-in reality
excluded: stabilizer chemistry detail and dosing (supplier TDS)
decomposition rescue and filtration practice (sibling lifecycle KB)
sulfite titration and feeding (sibling analysis KB)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: logged bath-life experience or supplier stabilizer changes that shift the family's real cost, and any wear-claim failures on its soft deposits

pros.claim: Removes the entire acute-lethality tier from the gold line, making lawful small-shop and residential operation realistic
pros.example: a spare-room studio runs a lidded one-liter sulfite bath with mechanical stirring and sleeps at night, where any free-cyanide bath would be untenable on license, insurance and conscience

cons.claim: The bath dies on the shelf as well as in use, and the family's soft deposit cannot carry hard-wear promises unaided
cons.example: a generously sized sulfite tank bought for a busy month gilds its own heater during a quiet one, and the ring plated from it scratches in a week of daily wear unless thickness or a topcoat compensates

failure_modes: sized and treated like a cyanide bath, with bath death arriving as a surprise instead of a budget line
hard-wear jobs accepted on the family's safety story with the wear compensation never engineered
an arsenic-hardened variant adopted casually as 'still cyanide-free', skipping the hazmat re-assessment
acceptance_tests: any selection naming this family records the wear-class compensation plan (thickness, topcoat class, or renegotiated promise) and notes bath life as a costed consumable
revisit_triggers: bath mortality in the log diverging from what selection priced in
a supplier reformulates the stabilizer package or the shop considers a hardened variant

nodes.definition: Position the near-neutral golds as a class between the strongly alkaline and acid poles: systems formulated to run around neutral pH - the mixed sulfite-thiosulfate baths whose stronger thiosulfate complexation is the published route to near-neutral operation, and the neutral-type immersion golds documented to corrode nickel less than their acid counterparts. The selection logic of the class is gentleness: near-neutral chemistry spares substrates, resists and existing decorative layers that strong alkali or acid would attack, and it softens (without abolishing) the drag-in sensitivity at the prep boundary. The class is thinner in the market than the big families, mostly electronics-oriented, and much of its formulation detail is supplier-proprietary - so this node deliberately claims less: it teaches when to go looking for a near-neutral product and what to demand from its TDS, not what such baths universally contain.

included: near-neutral operation as a published class trait and its substrate-gentleness rationale
mixed-ligand and neutral immersion variants as documented members
when a job's sensitivity sends the search toward this class
excluded: any claim of universal composition or window (thin corpus grounding; supplier TDS governs)
electronics process design
immersion mechanics beyond class positioning (electroless node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: supplier documentation or corpus additions that thicken the class's evidence base beyond its current passing mentions

pros.claim: A gentler chemistry class for pieces whose substrate or prior decoration cannot take the alkaline or acid poles
pros.example: a part carrying a delicate existing finish that hot alkali would haze gets gold from a near-neutral product chosen for exactly that tolerance

cons.claim: Thin market and proprietary depth mean the class is chosen on supplier evidence the shop cannot independently benchmark
cons.example: the bench comparing two near-neutral products has little handbook ground to stand on and must lean on TDS claims and its own qualification coupons

failure_modes: the class invoked as a universal peacemaker when the job actually needs a mainstream family's strengths
class-level gentleness assumed to mean chemically inert toward every substrate
handbook gaps filled with invented composition claims
revisit_triggers: a supplier TDS or corpus update adds real documentation to the class

nodes.definition: Know the rectifier-free class for what it is and is not: immersion (displacement) gold plates by the workpiece's own surface metal dissolving in exchange and self-terminates once gold covers the surface, capping thickness at a published flash-class ceiling around a tenth of a micron - a mechanism no dwell time extends, with over-dwell actively corroding the nickel beneath (the canonical black-pad failure). Autocatalytic electroless gold adds a chemical reducer to build real thickness slowly, at the price of the fussiest, least stable baths in the gold repertoire. The class rides on electroless nickel-phosphorus, whose perfectly uniform, current-blind coverage is the genuine star. Its honest selection roles at a jewelry bench: metallization front-end for non-conductors, uniform barrier and gold seed on filigree, hollow and recessed pieces that rack electroplating starves, and an honestly labeled budget gold-flash tier - never the wear finish, and never any part of a plate-then-form flow, because nickel-phosphorus is brittle by published characteristic.

included: the self-limiting displacement ceiling as mechanism
autocatalytic build as a slow, fragile thickness class
electroless nickel-phosphorus uniformity as the class's real virtue
the three honest jewelry roles and the two hard prohibitions
excluded: EN bath loading, metal-turnover life and crash management (sibling lifecycle and analysis KBs)
sensitize-activate metallization steps in procedure (prep/process specialists)
operating windows (product TDS)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: field failures or supplier documentation that shift where the class's honest roles begin and end at a jewelry bench

pros.claim: Chemical deposition ignores current distribution, coating geometry that defeats every electroplating family, with no rectifier hardware at all
pros.example: a hollow filigree bead whose inner surfaces rack-plate bald comes out of the electroless route uniformly barriered and gold-seeded, ready for a decorative electroplate top

cons.claim: The immersion ceiling is physics, so the class tempts dishonest 'gold dipped' selling at flash thickness
cons.example: a 'liquid gold dip' kit product wears through to grey nickel in weeks on a daily-wear ring, exactly as the mechanism predicts, and the claim conversation happens with an angry customer instead of at selection

failure_modes: immersion gold sold or specified as a wear finish
dwell extended past plateau chasing thickness, buying nickel corrosion instead
the class used under a piece that will later be formed, cracking the brittle nickel-phosphorus
acceptance_tests: any selection using this class states its role (metallization front-end, uniform barrier/seed, or honest flash tier) and the label class the product will carry, with wear claims explicitly excluded at flash thickness
revisit_triggers: a job or product line starts leaning on immersion gold for wear duty
quality reports black-pad-pattern failures from the class's dwell practice

nodes.definition: Maintain the comparison an expert actually holds in their head, written down: for each family - alkaline cyanide, acid hard, sulfite cyanide-free, electroless/immersion - the published-class positions on deposit hardness and ductility, cathode efficiency, throwing power, strike and activation strength, color repertoire, bath stability and life, hazard tier and obligation classes, and entry cost of gold locked in solution. The benchmark exists so family choice is an argument over a shared table instead of a loyalty contest: cyanide is the stable, efficient, ductile reference behind the heaviest gate; acid hard gold is the wear king that is brittle, low-throw and still gated; sulfite trades life and hardness for safety; electroless trades thickness for geometry-blind uniformity. Every cell cites its corpus or TDS class source, every gap stays an honest gap, and the shop's own qualification coupons progressively overwrite priors with its lived evidence.

included: the axis set and each family's class position with source tags
gap honesty where the corpus is silent
coupon-driven updating of the shop's own copy
excluded: per-product data (TDS)
axis positions invented to complete the table
process settings of any kind

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: accumulated coupon and field evidence, or corpus revisions, that move any family's class position on any axis

pros.claim: A written benchmark makes family selection auditable and teachable instead of tribal
pros.example: when a trade account pushes for 'the hardest gold you have' on a hinged bracelet, the bench points at the ductility row, not at a feeling, and the account accepts the soft-build-plus-hard-flash compromise

cons.claim: Class-level rows flatten real product differences and can ossify into dogma if never fed with coupons
cons.example: two commercial sulfite products differ meaningfully in stability, and a benchmark row that says only 'sulfite: short life' steers the shop past the better one

failure_modes: cells filled by plausibility instead of tagged sources
the benchmark treated as finished, never updated from qualification or field results
family rows quietly applied as product verdicts
acceptance_tests: the benchmark covers all four family rows across the stated axes with a source tag or an explicit gap in every cell, and shows at least a dated revision trail
revisit_triggers: any qualification coupon or field failure contradicting a cell
a corpus or supplier documentation change touching a family's class position

nodes.definition: Understand color as alloying, not paint: a pure gold deposit is the rich warm yellow of fine gold, and every departure is a co-deposited metal shifting it - copper pulls toward pink and rose, silver toward green golds, nickel toward pale green-white, palladium toward white, and even the hardener in an acid gold tints it (cobalt warm, nickel paler). Because the color coat is an alloy, its effective karat drops below 24k by recipe - the corpus places common decorative color coats in the 18-23k effective range as a handbook class - which is why color language and karat claims are the same conversation. The industry's named tones (the 1N-3N class of color references, Hamilton and rose numbers) are supplier recipes tuned in commercial products, not formulas a bench derives; the mechanism knowledge exists so the jeweler can predict direction - why a rose bath drifts yellow as its copper depletes, why a green gold needs silver in solution - and buy the right product, while hue-versus-drift management in service belongs to the analysis KB.

included: alloy-direction mechanism per metal as published chemistry
effective-karat consequence of alloying as a handbook class
named color standards as supplier-recipe classes
direction-of-drift prediction as selection literacy
excluded: hue recipe quantities (proprietary; supplier TDS)
in-service color drift control and color measurement discipline (analysis KB and quality specialist)
solid-gold alloy metallurgy beyond deposit relevance

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: coupon results or supplier documentation that correct the shop's mental map of which alloy moves hue in which direction and how far

pros.claim: Mechanism literacy lets the bench translate customer color language into a bath requirement before buying anything
pros.example: 'rose like this bracelet' becomes 'a copper-alloyed color product over a yellow build', and the bench asks suppliers the right question instead of ordering three wrong kits

cons.claim: Direction knowledge without recipes can breed overconfidence about achievable tones
cons.example: knowing copper means rose does not mean any rose is reachable on the shop's line; the exact tone still lives in a supplier's recipe and must be proven on a coupon

failure_modes: karat claims made from the build bath's purity while an alloyed color coat tops the piece
hue direction confused (nickel expected to warm, copper to pale)
a named tone promised before any product on the line can produce it
revisit_triggers: customer color vocabulary or reference standards the mechanism map cannot yet translate

nodes.definition: Turn a hue target into a bath decision: match the brief's color reference to what the installed line can deposit, choose the color route - pure build color left as-is, a lean alloyed color-flash coat over the build, or a color coat over a white palladium or nickel-class underlayer for pale tones - and name the retained standard the result will be judged against. The decision is line-aware and honest: classic alloyed color-flash repertoire lives in the cyanide family; pure sulfite gold gives a beautifully stable 24k yellow precisely because it will not alloy, so rose and green targets on a cyanide-free line are a capability conversation, not a promise; hardener tint in acid golds sets tone within a narrow band the supplier owns. The color decision also fixes claim language, because an alloyed coat changes the karat story the seller may tell. What this node does not do is chase hue in service - drift diagnosis belongs to the analysis KB; this node decides what the line will be asked to produce.

included: hue-target-to-route mapping on the installed line
retained-standard naming as the acceptance anchor
capability honesty for cyanide-free and hardener-tint limits
karat-claim consequence of the chosen route
excluded: in-service hue drift and its correction (analysis KB)
lighting and measurement method for color judgment (quality specialist)
recipe contents (supplier)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: coupon-versus-standard results, customer color disputes, or line changes that alter which routes deliver which tones

pros.claim: Choosing the color route against a named retained standard makes 'matches' decidable before the customer is involved
pros.example: the coupon from the candidate rose flash is set beside the shop's retained rose plaque under the bench light, and the yes/no is recorded with the selection instead of argued at handover

cons.claim: Color routes multiply tanks and coupons for a benefit some jobs cannot perceive
cons.example: a matte-finished piece destined for a dim display case gets a dedicated color-flash step whose tone difference from the build bath no buyer will ever see

failure_modes: hue promised from a catalog photo with no retained standard behind it
a rose target accepted onto a line whose only gold is pure sulfite
color route chosen before the wear class fixed the build, so the tone rides on a stack that then changes
revisit_triggers: the retained standard set no longer spans what customers ask for
a line change (family swap, new hardener) moves the tones the routes produce

nodes.definition: Choose the non-gold baths that make the gold succeed, as classes: nickel underplate - the single biggest wear-life and brightness lever under thin gold, split into bright (leveling, mirror, brightener-embrittled) and sulfamate (ductile, low-stress, formable) sub-classes, and always trailing the nickel-release compliance flag for skin-contact goods; copper - the leveler and adhesion bridge class, historically the strike answer on difficult substrates like zinc die-cast; palladium - the nickel-free barrier and whitening class that buys hypoallergenic stacks and blocks diffusion at precious-metal cost. Support baths are selected with, not after, the gold family: they set what the gold sits on, whether the stack may bend, what the compliance story is, and whether a silver or copper substrate will bleed into the gold over time. Their own operating windows are their products' TDS business; their execution order and thickness delivery belong to the process specialist's layer architecture - this node decides which classes the job's stack needs and why.

included: nickel, copper and palladium as selection classes with their stack roles
bright-versus-sulfamate nickel as a formability and finish decision
the compliance flags each class drags in
diffusion-barrier reasoning at class level
excluded: layer thickness targets and execution sequence (process specialist)
support-bath maintenance (sibling analysis KB)
asserted nickel-release numbers (regulated class, verify jurisdiction)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: compliance-rule movement, field-failure patterns, or supplier changes that alter which support class a stack role should default to

pros.claim: Choosing support classes with the gold prevents stacks that pass the tank and fail the customer
pros.example: a bright-nickel underplate chosen for mirror leveling is swapped to sulfamate when the brief reveals the bangle will be sprung open at fitting, saving the stack from cracking at the jeweler's bench

cons.claim: Every support class is another tank, another chemistry and often another compliance thread to hold
cons.example: adding a palladium barrier line for occasional hypoallergenic work parks precious-metal inventory and a new TDS discipline on a bench that uses it monthly

failure_modes: nickel chosen by default with the release-compliance flag never raised on skin-contact goods
bright nickel under a piece that will flex, embrittling the stack
no barrier under thin gold on silver or copper, so the substrate migrates and the color dies in months
acceptance_tests: every stack proposal names its support classes with the reason each is present and the compliance flag each raises, and skin-contact jobs show either a nickel-free class or an explicit verified-stack note
revisit_triggers: a compliance rule change touching nickel or the trade book's markets
field failures (color fade, cracking) tracing to a support-class choice

nodes.definition: Map the verified substrate class to the stack it may lawfully and physically receive: bare steel and zinc die-cast never meet a gold bath directly - iron and zinc displace gold as a non-adherent smut and poison the bath - so their routes run through strike and barrier classes (the corpus's canonical steel stack: clean, activate, nickel-class barrier, gold strike, gold build); stainless is inert until its passive film is broken by a Wood's-strike-class activation the prep line owns; silver takes the vermeil route but demands a barrier or thickness against tarnish migration into thin gold; copper and brass plate readily but interdiffuse with gold over time, wanting a barrier for anything meant to last. Family compatibility is part of the map - the acid line chemically attacks bare steel where the alkaline family is gentler, an accidental-touch difference that matters in a mixed shop. The bench consumes prep's substrate verdict; what it owns here is the stack consequence, and refusing any 'just gold it directly' request that the doctrine forbids.

included: substrate-class-to-stack mapping with displacement and diffusion rationale
family compatibility per substrate class
the hard refusals (bare steel or zinc direct to gold)
consumption of prep's verified substrate class
excluded: substrate identification and triage (surface-prep specialist)
activation procedure and timing (prep line)
layer thickness execution (process specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new substrate class in the job mix, or stack failures that falsify a row of the map

pros.claim: A written substrate-to-stack map turns the most expensive category of plating failure into a lookup
pros.example: the 'brass' medal prep re-classed as zinc die-cast is routed through the copper-strike class doctrine instead of straight to gold, and the bath poisoning that route would have caused never happens

cons.claim: Doctrine-level maps cannot see piece-level pathologies and can over-promise once a rare substrate arrives
cons.example: a repaired piece with lead solder at the joints follows the brass row of the map perfectly and still blisters, because the map speaks in classes and the piece had a local exception only triage could flag

failure_modes: gold attempted directly on a displacement-prone substrate to save a step
the map applied to the customer's claimed metal instead of prep's verified class
silver plated thin with no barrier, trading a fast job for a color complaint months later
acceptance_tests: every selection shows the substrate class as received from prep and the stack row applied to it, and no route exists on paper from bare steel or zinc die-cast directly into any gold bath
revisit_triggers: prep hands over a substrate class the map has no row for
a stack failure in the field contradicts the map's row for that class

nodes.definition: Match what the piece must survive to what a deposit class can deliver, honestly: flash and color-gilding thickness is decoration measured in months of gentle wear; the published marking ladder (flash, gold-electroplate class, micron plating, heavy and vermeil classes) is cited as the regulated class structure it is, with thresholds verified in the selling jurisdiction rather than recited; soft golds - cyanide 24k and sulfite alike - sit in the published soft-hardness class and smear or scratch under daily abrasion at any thinness; hard golds sit in the published hard class and carry rings and bracelets; immersion flash sits below the ladder's floor and carries nothing. The matching runs both ways: a wear promise selects a deposit class and minimum thickness class, and an installed line's deposit classes bound which promises sales may make. Where the line cannot meet the promise, the honest outputs are a thicker or harder route, a disclosed softer expectation, or a declined job - never a quiet flash sold as plate. Thickness verification itself is the quality specialist's method business.

included: wear-class to deposit-class and thickness-class mapping
the marking ladder as a regulated class structure with verify-jurisdiction pointers
line-capability bounding of sales promises
the three honest outputs when demand exceeds capability
excluded: thickness measurement and acceptance testing (quality specialist)
wear-life numbers promised as fact (mechanism and disclosure only)
pricing the difference (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: complaint and return patterns per wear class, or regulatory movement in the marking ladder

pros.claim: Class-level matching lets the bench promise durability in defensible language
pros.example: a customer hears 'daily-wear micron class in hard gold, or flash refresh yearly - here is the difference' instead of a wear-life number nobody can stand behind

cons.claim: Honest class language can lose sales to competitors who promise wear-life figures they never substantiate
cons.example: the shop quoting 'flash class, decorative wear' watches a customer leave for a 'guaranteed two years' listing of the same thickness

failure_modes: a soft flash quietly shipped against a daily-wear expectation
marking-class thresholds recited from memory as law instead of verified per jurisdiction
wear promises made from the family's best case rather than the chosen class and thickness
acceptance_tests: every job's record shows wear class, deposit class and thickness class agreeing with each other and with the claim language, or shows the disclosed-downgrade or decline conversation instead
revisit_triggers: returns or complaints clustering on a wear-class row
a marking-rule change in a jurisdiction the trade book sells into

nodes.definition: Apply the constraint that saves rings: deposits differ by published characteristic in how they take bending, and the flow must be designed around that before the family is fixed. Cobalt- and nickel-hardened acid golds are brittle - elongation well under a percent - and microcrack at any real bend, taking the compliance story with them as cracks expose nickel beneath; nickel-phosphorus under the electroless class is worse; bright nickel underplate embrittles an otherwise ductile stack; while soft cyanide gold and undoped sulfite gold are the ductile end, with sulfite gold the one deposit class where gentle post-plate forming over a sulfamate-nickel underplate is defensible at all - bought by spending wear resistance. The default answer is always form first, plate second, and any resize-after-plating request re-opens family selection rather than being absorbed as an execution detail. Where forming after plating is truly fixed, the constraint disqualifies the brittle classes outright and writes the wear trade-off into the customer conversation.

included: published ductility ranking across deposit and underplate classes
form-first as the default flow decision
the narrow soft-sulfite allowance and its wear price
resize requests as selection re-openers
excluded: bend radii, bake schedules and forming technique (process specialist and the goldsmith's bench)
adhesion testing method (quality specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: bend-failure evidence or published data that moves a deposit class's position in the ductility ranking

pros.claim: Sequencing the flow around ductility prevents the cracked-at-the-jeweler failure that no bath quality can fix
pros.example: a trade account's ring blanks are plated after sizing rather than before, and the hard-gold flash that would have crazed at every size-up never gets the chance

cons.claim: Form-first collides with business models built on plating stock before final fit
cons.example: a maker who plates finished inventory rings loses the walk-in resize sale, or must hold unplated blanks and plate to order at slower turnaround

failure_modes: a resize request handled at the polishing bench without re-opening the deposit question
the sulfite allowance stretched to hard bends or hardened variants
bright nickel left under a stack that the brief says will flex
acceptance_tests: every brief answers the forming question, and any job marked form-after-plate shows either a ductile-class stack with disclosed wear cost or a declined/reflowed job - never a brittle class
revisit_triggers: cracking failures at bends reported by quality or accounts

nodes.definition: Read the piece's geometry as a selection input: open convex surfaces accept any family, but recesses, bores, hollows, chain and filigree sort the families hard. Alkaline cyanide's high complexant conductivity gives it the best electroplating throw; acid hard gold, gold-lean and diffusion-limited, starves recesses and belongs on accessible wear surfaces; and the electroless class ignores current distribution entirely, coating inner surfaces identically to outer - the published mechanism that makes an EN-front-end-plus-electroplate-top hybrid the honest route for complex hollow work. The matching prevents two classic errors: shipping a filigree piece whose crevices are bald under a bright exterior, and blaming the rectifier or the operator for what was a family mismatch at selection. What geometry work does not belong here: shields, auxiliary anodes, barrel-versus-rack choices and all current-distribution craft are the process specialist's tools applied after the family is right, not substitutes for choosing it.

included: geometry classing (open, recessed, hollow, filigree, chain)
family throw capabilities as published class traits
the hybrid electroless-then-electroplate route decision
mismatch-versus-execution diagnosis at selection level
excluded: fixturing, shielding and auxiliary-anode craft (process specialist)
throwing-power measurement (analysis KB's method classes)
operating parameters (TDS)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: coverage-defect patterns per geometry class, or process-bench evidence that fixturing reliably rescues a geometry the matching routes away

pros.claim: Geometry-aware selection stops the line from asking a family for coverage it cannot physically give
pros.example: a hollow openwork locket is routed through electroless barrier and seed before its decorative gold top, instead of three rack-plating attempts each leaving grey pockets deeper than the last

cons.claim: Family-level throw rules can under-credit what skilled fixturing rescues, routing jobs away that the process bench could have carried
cons.example: a moderately recessed pendant is sent down the hybrid route with its extra tanks and days, when an auxiliary anode in experienced hands would have covered it in one

failure_modes: acid hard gold specified across deep-recess geometry because its wear class matched the brief
coverage failures debugged as execution while the family mismatch repeats
the hybrid route's extra cost sprung on the customer after selection instead of quoted
revisit_triggers: recess-coverage defects recurring on a geometry class the matching passed

nodes.definition: Attach every regulated flag to the selection while it can still change the stack: nickel anywhere under skin-contact gold raises the nickel-release obligation class (with its jurisdiction-defined limits and test standards verified current, never recited), steering piercing goods and sensitive-skin jobs toward nickel-free barrier classes; the marking vocabulary - gold plated, vermeil, gold filled, rolled gold - is a set of regulated term classes whose thresholds live in the selling jurisdiction's current rules, so a vermeil order forces a silver substrate and a thickness class check, and gold-filled is a fabrication class no bath can produce; food-contact and allergy questions route to regulation classes and professional care, not bench opinion. The node's discipline is timing and honesty: flags raised at selection cost a different bath choice; flags discovered at sale cost strip-and-restack or a withdrawn claim. This bench flags and routes - final legal sign-off on claims is a human, jurisdiction-checked act, and nothing here is legal advice.

included: nickel-release class flagging on skin-contact stacks
regulated marking terms as claim classes with verify-jurisdiction pointers
food-contact and allergy routing to regulation classes and professional care
flag timing as a selection input
excluded: asserting numeric limits or thresholds as fact
approving claims (human, jurisdiction-checked)
the marking-compliance deep dive (safety-compliance specialist's territory)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: regulatory changes, market expansion, or a claim dispute that exposes a missing flag row

pros.claim: Flags raised at selection are cheap; the same flags at sale are strip-and-restack or a retracted promise
pros.example: the piercing-post pair flagged at selection gets a palladium-class barrier from the start, instead of a finished nickel-under-gold lot that cannot be honestly sold into its market

cons.claim: Verify-jurisdiction discipline adds friction and can stall simple jobs in caution
cons.example: a routine domestic-market pendant waits two days while the current vermeil wording is re-confirmed, though nothing had changed since last month's check

failure_modes: nickel-release raised only after a customer reacts
vermeil claimed over a brass core because the gold was thick enough by someone's memory of a rule
threshold numbers hardened into shop lore and recited as law across jurisdictions
acceptance_tests: every selection record shows the claim-flag sheet: nickel-release status of the stack, marking-class check for every claim word in the sale, and a verify-jurisdiction note with date for each flag raised
revisit_triggers: regulatory movement in any market the trade book touches
a claim word appearing in sales language that the flag sheet has no row for

nodes.definition: Hold the line where the wet bench honestly ends: PVD and related dry-coating routes are named here only as an out-of-scope alternative class, and the selection skill is recognizing their jobs early - the stainless watch case wanting a hard ceramic-toned coating, the request to match an existing PVD finish whose look no gold electrodeposit reproduces, the non-conductive object whose owner does not want the wet metallization chain, the demand for coating hardness beyond what any electroplated gold class reaches. For these, the honest verdict at brief time is 'this is not a wet-plating job', delivered with a referral rather than a stretched attempt; the boundary protects both the customer (who gets the right process) and the bench (which does not burn gold and reputation approximating one). The node deliberately teaches no PVD selection or operation - naming the class and the referral behavior is its entire content, and the temptation it guards against is the bench treating every gold-colored request as an electroplating request.

included: the job patterns that belong to the dry-coating class
the early route-out question in the brief
referral as the honest verdict
excluded: PVD technology, selection or vendors (entirely out of scope)
wet metallization of non-conductors (that IS in-scope via the electroless class)
competitive process comparison beyond the referral decision

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: referral outcomes showing the boundary drawn too tight or too loose for the shop's actual capability

pros.claim: A named boundary converts unwinnable jobs into goodwill referrals instead of failures
pros.example: the customer with a blackened-steel bracelet wanting 'that gunmetal look, but gold accents' hears the honest split - PVD house for the body, this bench for the accent parts - and returns with the work the bench can win

cons.claim: Boundary conservatism forfeits jobs the wet line could genuinely serve
cons.example: a matte dark-gold request that a plated finish over a dark nickel-class underlayer could have met is referred out because it pattern-matched to PVD looks

failure_modes: a PVD-class job accepted and approximated with plating until the customer compares finishes
the boundary invoked to dodge any unfamiliar wet job rather than genuinely out-of-scope work
referral made without recording why, so the same evaluation repeats next time
revisit_triggers: referral-pattern review showing winnable wet jobs routinely routed out

nodes.definition: Size each tank as a capital and mortality decision, not a convenience: dissolved gold is inventory - the corpus's arithmetic example of tens of grams of gold sitting in a modest build bath before the first piece plates is the class of number every sizing decision must confront - and different families punish oversizing differently. Sulfite baths age and die even unused, so their size follows throughput or the shop pays in dead baths; cyanide builds are long-lived but lock the most metal; strikes stay deliberately small everywhere because they are sacrificial by design; lean immersion baths are the cheapest gold entry in the repertoire. Sizing also interacts with the capability gate - more cyanide volume on premises can mean a different storage and licensing posture - and with the job mix, since a bath sized for a hoped-for trade book that never arrives is pure locked capital. The recurring economics of bath death, regeneration and gold recovery belong to the lifecycle KB; what selection owns is the make-up size and tank count the shop commits to on day one and at every family change.

included: gold-in-solution as inventory in the sizing decision
family-specific oversizing penalties (sulfite mortality, cyanide lock-up)
strike smallness as doctrine
sizing's interaction with capability posture and job mix
excluded: regenerate-versus-replace and recovery economics in service (lifecycle KB)
invented price figures (gold-mass arithmetic classes only)
quoting and margins (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: throughput history, bath-mortality logs, or gold-price movement that re-ranks the shop's sizing choices

pros.claim: Sizing to throughput keeps the shop's gold working on pieces instead of aging in tanks
pros.example: a bench replacing its hopeful five-liter sulfite tank with one liter plus scheduled remakes stops writing off dead gold-bearing baths every slow quarter

cons.claim: Small baths run out of headroom exactly when a big order lands and cost more per liter to keep in spec
cons.example: a surprise fifty-piece trade lot meets a one-liter build bath that depletes mid-run, and the little-and-often discipline the analysis KB teaches becomes an hourly chore

failure_modes: tanks sized to the dream book instead of the actual one
sulfite volume treated as future-proofing when it is scheduled mortality
strike allowed to grow into a second build bath because the tank was there
revisit_triggers: sustained job-mix change in either direction

nodes.definition: Stand between the catalog and the customer: no new commercial bath system - however reputable the supplier - carries customer work until it is qualified on this shop's line. Qualification is a fixed small ritual: the TDS and SDS on file and read against the capability register; the cyanide-class question answered from the safety documentation, not the product name; compatibility checked against existing rinses, drains and the segregation layout; a small make-up per the TDS run on scrap or witness coupons; and the coupons judged against the retained color standard and an adhesion check before any commitment. The trial's methods (coupon, visual against standard, tape or bend check) are method classes shared with the quality bench - what selection owns is the gate itself: the rule that a qualification record exists before the first customer piece, that a failed trial sends the product back regardless of sunk cost, and that requalification triggers on any reformulation, because a 'same name, new formula' bath is a new product wearing an old label.

included: the qualification ritual and its documentation
cyanide-class and compatibility screening before trial
the scrap-first rule and the failed-trial verdict
requalification on reformulation or substitution
excluded: ongoing analysis and control of the qualified bath (analysis KB)
test-method technique detail (quality specialist)
supplier commercial terms (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a trial failure pattern, a reformulation incident that slipped through, or field divergence from qualification results

pros.claim: A qualification gate converts supplier claims into shop evidence before reputation rides on them
pros.example: the new rose flash that photographed beautifully in the catalog turns muddy over this shop's nickel on the coupon, and the discovery costs one scrap disc instead of a trade account

cons.claim: Qualification time and make-up cost land on every product change, including urgent ones
cons.example: when the incumbent build bath is discontinued mid-season, the replacement still waits for its coupon day while jobs queue

a familiar product's reformulation waved through on the old qualification
trial coupons judged by memory instead of the retained standard
acceptance_tests: every bath on the line points at a dated qualification record with its coupon verdicts, and no selection record cites a product whose qualification is missing or predates a known reformulation
revisit_triggers: supplier reformulation, substitution or discontinuation notices
