nodes.definition: Close every selection with the artifact the rest of the shop runs on: a record naming the family and the specific commercial product for each bath role the job uses, the support-bath classes under them, the substrate class and stack row applied, the wear and color classes promised with their claim flags, the qualification records relied on, and the rationale in two honest sentences - including what was considered and rejected and why. The record cites the product TDS for every operating specific rather than restating numbers, opens the bath-log header that the analysis KB's discipline will fill in service, and hands the process specialist an unambiguous stack to execute. Its quiet second job is institutional memory: when the same trade account's reorder arrives in eight months, or when a field failure comes back for diagnosis, the record is the difference between evidence and archaeology - and its feedback loop into the next brief is how the bench's selection instincts actually improve.

included: the record's required fields and rejection rationale
TDS citation in place of restated numbers
bath-log header opening as the analysis-KB handoff
the reorder and failure-diagnosis memory role
excluded: running the bath log in service (analysis KB)
execution parameters (process specialist reads the TDS)
customer-facing paperwork (business specialist)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: records failing their readers - a reorder, dispute or diagnosis that needed a field the template lacks

pros.claim: A written record with rejection rationale makes every future selection faster and every failure diagnosable
pros.example: when a pendant comes back dull after a summer, the record shows which build bath, which color route and which stack row it got, and diagnosis starts from facts instead of recollection

cons.claim: Records cost minutes on every job and decay into ritual if nobody reads them back
cons.example: a year of dutifully filed selection records that no reorder or failure review ever opened is pure overhead until the day one dispute pays for them all

failure_modes: the record restates setpoint numbers, quietly becoming a rival authority to the TDS
rejection rationale omitted, so the next selector re-litigates the same dead ends
the bath-log header skipped, breaking the handoff the analysis KB depends on
acceptance_tests: every committed job has a record naming product-per-role, stack row, claim flags, qualification references and rejection rationale, citing the TDS for operating specifics, with the bath-log header opened
revisit_triggers: reorders or failure reviews finding records missing a field they needed
the analysis or lifecycle KBs changing what the log header must carry

edges.why_related: the role map is drawn for a specific job, so the brief's wear, color and geometry answers decide which roles exist at all
the strike doctrine details the first and most safety-critical of the roles the architecture names
family knowledge is consumed role-by-role - the cyanide family is evaluated as a candidate strike, build and color filler
acid hard gold is meaningful to selection as a build and wear-surface role candidate within the role map
the sulfite family's fit is judged per role - strong as a safe build, weak as a strike - which requires the role frame first
the electroless class slots into the role map as front-end, barrier or flash tier, never as a build role, and that placement presupposes the roles
the near-neutral class is positioned relative to the reference chemistry's poles - its meaning depends on knowing what strongly alkaline operation is
the benchmark's cyanide row is filled from this family's published traits and obligation classes
the benchmark's hard-gold row - wear class, brittleness, throw, gate status - comes from this family node
the benchmark's cyanide-free row - safety, bath life, softness, strike weakness - comes from this family node
the benchmark's electroless row - geometry blindness, thickness ceiling, no-rectifier economics - comes from this class node
choosing a color route presupposes knowing which alloy moves hue in which direction and what it does to effective karat
the stack map's family-compatibility column reads directly off the benchmark's rows
every stack row is built from the support classes - barriers, strikes and levelers - that the substrate demands
wear matching maps promises onto the hardness and thickness classes the benchmark says each family can deliver
qualification's first step is the document discipline - no TDS and SDS on file, no trial
the record commits the stack row the substrate matching produced
the record carries the wear-class promise and its deposit and thickness classes as decided by the matching
the committed color route and its retained standard are fields of the record
the route-out question is asked of the brief - the boundary reads the job pattern the brief captures
the cyanide family may only be selected inside a licensed, segregated, monitored and trained envelope - the gate is a hard precondition, not a preference
the record must cite products and their TDS for operating specifics and may never restate or invent setpoints
no stack row may route a displacement-prone substrate into gold without a strike and live entry - the doctrine binds every row
marking-term classes bound which wear and thickness promises may be worded as claims, so the flag sheet constrains the matching's outputs
alloying the color coat lowers the coating's effective karat, which is what makes karat wording a compliance question rather than a copy choice
the weak complex's spontaneous decomposition causes finite shelf life, which is the mechanism forcing sulfite tanks to be sized to throughput
inclusion hardening is what makes the hard-gold deposit brittle, and that published mechanism is the root of the form-first rule
chemical deposition's indifference to current distribution is what creates the geometry routing option the matching exploits for hollow and filigree work
the build class is settled before the color coat is chosen, because the tone rides on the stack the wear decision fixes
qualification completes before the record commits - a selection is only recordable once its products carry dated qualification evidence
reorders, disputes and failure diagnoses read old records and reshape what the next brief asks up front
every qualification coupon is shop-local evidence that overwrites the benchmark's priors for that family and product class
both are built on the same galvanic displacement reaction - immersion gold harnesses on purpose the very exchange the strike exists to suppress, and understanding one deepens the other
hard-wear demand collides with the cyanide-free family's soft deposit class, and the collision is where dishonest promises are born
edges.resolution_rule: the capability gate rules first; within a cyanide-free line the wear promise is met by thickness or a supplier-sanctioned topcoat class, renegotiated downward with disclosure, or declined - a soft flash is never silently shipped against a wear promise

edges.why_related: rose and green hue targets collide with the pure sulfite bath's refusal to alloy - its color stability is exactly its color inflexibility
edges.resolution_rule: line capability is checked before any hue is promised: offer the achievable pure-gold tone, add a qualified alloyed color product where the envelope allows one, or route the job to a line that can - never promise a hue the installed baths cannot deposit

edges.why_related: recessed and hollow geometry collides with the diffusion-limited acid bath's poor throw exactly on the jobs whose wear class wants hard gold
edges.resolution_rule: geometry evidence wins: deep recesses route to a better-throwing family or an electroless front-end with hard gold reserved for the accessible wear surfaces, and a coverage-compromised hard-gold run is not attempted to honor a wear preference

edges.why_related: post-plate forming intent collides head-on with the hard-gold deposit's published brittleness
edges.resolution_rule: form-first dominates: if forming after plating is fixed in the brief, the hardened classes are disqualified outright and the job runs ductile-class with disclosed wear cost, or the flow is re-sequenced to form before plate

edges.why_related: nickel underplate's performance virtues collide with the nickel-release obligation class on skin-contact goods
edges.resolution_rule: compliance beats performance: skin-contact stacks use a nickel-free barrier class or a stack verified against the jurisdiction's release class - the brighter, cheaper nickel row never overrides the flag

edges.why_related: the brief's deadline collides with the qualification gate whenever a job needs a bath the shop has not proven
edges.resolution_rule: no customer piece enters an unqualified bath: the deadline moves, the job runs on a qualified alternative with disclosed differences, or it is declined or referred - sunk urgency never waives the trial

edges.why_related: the 'it's only a mild acid bath' temptation collides with the fact that its gold salt is an acutely toxic cyanide compound behind the same gate as the alkaline family
edges.resolution_rule: any product containing a gold-cyanide salt is handled as cyanide-class for licensing, storage and segregation regardless of bath pH or marketing language - the gate's verdict is final and marketing never reclassifies chemistry

conflict_axes.name: wear_performance_vs_hazard_tier
conflict_axes.description: The deposits that carry daily wear best live behind the heaviest safety gates, while the safest chemistry produces the softest gold - the central tension of gold-family selection.
poles: best wear deposit whatever the gate
lowest hazard line whatever the wear cost
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the lawful capability envelope decides first and is never argued against a deadline; inside it, wear is bought with thickness, topcoat classes or honest downgrade disclosure

conflict_axes.name: color_ambition_vs_line_capability
conflict_axes.description: Customers ask for hues by feeling and photograph; the installed line deposits only what its families and qualified products can alloy.
poles: promise the hue the customer describes
promise only what the line has proven on coupons
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the achievable-tone conversation happens at the brief with the retained standards on the counter, and hue promises trace to a qualified product, not a catalog image

conflict_axes.name: deposit_hardness_vs_formability
conflict_axes.description: Hardness and ductility trade against each other across every gold class - the scratch-proof deposit cracks at the bend, the bendable deposit scratches.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the forming question is answered in the brief before family choice; form-first unlocks the hard classes, forming intent locks them out

conflict_axes.name: capability_breadth_vs_locked_gold
conflict_axes.description: Every additional family and tank widens what the bench can accept but locks more gold in solution and multiplies baths that age, especially on the cyanide-free side.
poles: keep every family ready for any job
run the minimum tanks the actual book needs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: size and count tanks from the trailing job mix, accept referral of rare jobs, and treat sulfite volume as scheduled mortality rather than capacity

conflict_axes.name: deadline_vs_qualification_discipline
conflict_axes.description: Urgent jobs pressure the bench to run unproven products or waved-through reformulations, precisely when a trial failure would hurt most.
poles: ship on the promised date whatever the bath's status
hold the qualification gate whatever the calendar says
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the gate holds; urgency is absorbed by qualified alternatives, moved dates or declined jobs, and the account is told the truth about why

conflict_axes.name: nickel_performance_vs_allergy_compliance
conflict_axes.description: Nickel underplate is the cheapest brightness and wear lever under thin gold and simultaneously the stack's biggest regulatory and allergy liability on skin-contact goods.
poles: default to nickel for leveling and wear
default to nickel-free stacks for skin contact
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: compliance class wins wherever skin contact is plausible; nickel survives only in stacks verified against the jurisdiction's release class, and allergy questions route to regulation classes and professional care

conflict_axes.name: flash_economy_vs_honest_wear_claims
conflict_axes.description: Flash and immersion tiers are the cheapest way to put real gold color on metal and the easiest products to oversell, because the buyer cannot see thickness.
poles: sell the affordable flash tier hard
claim only what the thickness class survives
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the flash tier exists honestly labeled - color product, months of gentle wear - and every claim word is checked against the marking class before sale, never after

conflict_axes.name: strike_overhead_vs_single_tank_simplicity
conflict_axes.description: The dedicated strike is pure overhead until the day it is the only thing standing between a displacement smut and the build bath - small shops feel the cost daily and the benefit rarely.
poles: fold striking into the main bath and save a tank
keep the sacrificial strike whatever the bench space
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: displacement-prone substrates and mixed drag-in work keep the strike, per doctrine; only a TDS-sanctioned main-bath strike condition on a clean, single-substrate line justifies folding it

conflict_axes.name: supplier_system_coherence_vs_lock_in
conflict_axes.description: Running one supplier's matched strike-build-color system maximizes documented compatibility and support, and simultaneously deepens dependence on that supplier's prices, stock and reformulation choices.
poles: one coherent supplier system per line
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: coherence wins by default because compatibility claims are then somebody's documented responsibility; any cross-supplier mix is treated as a new system requiring its own qualification

edge_cases.description: A customer orders a rose-gold heavy-wear ring from a bench whose only gold line is cyanide-free sulfite
edge_cases.trigger: hue target and wear class both exceed the installed line's capability at once
edge_cases.mitigation: run the achievable-tone and wear-class conversation at the brief: offer the stable pure-gold yellow at compensated thickness with disclosed wear expectations, or refer the job to a capable line - promise neither the hue nor the wear class the line cannot deliver

edge_cases.description: An heirloom silver locket needs gold, and thin gold straight over silver will lose its color as silver migrates through it
edge_cases.trigger: silver substrate meets a thin-gold selection with no barrier in the stack
edge_cases.mitigation: the stack row for silver demands a barrier class or a thickness class that outlives migration, and the vermeil-route claim check runs alongside; the piece-level custody decisions stay with prep triage

edge_cases.description: A 'just re-flash it' job arrives wearing an unknown existing plate of unknown family and thickness
edge_cases.trigger: prior coating unidentified at selection time
edge_cases.mitigation: the effective substrate is the existing coating, not the base metal: route through prep for coating identification, treat the surface as passivated and displacement-suspect, and select strike and stack for the verified answer rather than the assumption

edge_cases.description: A stainless steel band arrives, chemically inert behind its passive film, and the chosen gold system's normal entry will not adhere
edge_cases.trigger: passive-film substrate class enters family selection
edge_cases.mitigation: the stack row flags the activation-strike handoff to the prep line as mandatory, and the selection records that no gold family adheres to unactivated stainless - the family choice proceeds only on the activated stack

edge_cases.description: A hollow filigree pendant with deep interior recesses is quoted for rack electroplating and would ship with bald pockets
edge_cases.trigger: geometry class beyond electroplating throw enters selection
edge_cases.mitigation: route through the electroless front-end for uniform barrier and seed, with the decorative electroplate on top, and quote the hybrid route's cost at the brief instead of discovering it in rework

edge_cases.description: A piercing-post order lands on the default nickel-under-gold stack
edge_cases.trigger: skin-contact-critical goods meet a nickel-bearing stack proposal
edge_cases.mitigation: the flag sheet forces the nickel-free barrier class or a stack verified against the jurisdiction's release class before commitment, and the allergy conversation routes to regulation classes, never to bench reassurance

edge_cases.description: A trade account requests 'vermeil' on brass-cored pieces
edge_cases.trigger: a regulated term applied to a substrate its class definition excludes
edge_cases.mitigation: flag the term at the brief: vermeil is a silver-substrate class with jurisdiction-defined thickness and karat conditions, so the job either changes substrate, changes wording, or is declined as mislabeled - the bench never lends the word to the wrong stack

edge_cases.description: The supplier discontinues the shop's qualified color-flash product in the middle of a standing trade order
edge_cases.trigger: a committed selection's product disappears or reformulates mid-book
edge_cases.mitigation: the successor product runs full qualification against the retained color standard before any account piece; the account is told about the change and shown the coupon match rather than discovering a drifted tone across a reorder

edge_cases.description: A bargain 'gold plating solution' with no technical or safety documentation is offered online at half the price of the qualified product
edge_cases.trigger: an undocumented chemistry candidate reaches the shortlist
edge_cases.mitigation: the no-document-no-tank rule ends the evaluation: without TDS and SDS the product cannot be classed for the capability gate, cannot be qualified, and cannot be run - price never re-opens the question

edge_cases.description: A customer wants their newly plated ring resized 'while they wait'
edge_cases.trigger: post-plate forming demand arrives after the deposit family is already on the piece
edge_cases.mitigation: the deposit class on the ring decides: hard-gold and nickel-phosphorus stacks are refused resizing with the crack mechanism explained, and the honest offers are strip-size-replate or a disclosed-risk gentle adjustment only on a ductile-class stack

edge_cases.description: A mixed lot arrives - brass pendants and zinc die-cast medals - offered as one plating run
edge_cases.trigger: one batch spans substrate classes with incompatible stack routes
edge_cases.mitigation: split the batch by substrate class: the die-cast route needs its own strike-and-barrier doctrine and may exceed what the shop's line lawfully or practically runs, in which case those pieces are declined or referred rather than smuggled through the brass route

edge_cases.description: An immersion-gold 'dip kit' product is proposed as the shop's daily-wear gold service
edge_cases.trigger: a self-limiting flash-class chemistry is put forward for wear-class duty
edge_cases.mitigation: the published thickness ceiling closes the question: the kit may serve an honestly labeled flash tier, and every wear-class or 'gold plated' claim above its class is blocked at selection - the mechanism is explained to whoever proposed it, once, in the record

workflow.description: Turn the order into checkable selection inputs: color reference, wear class, verified substrate, geometry, claim words, forming intent, deadline
workflow.gate: no brief field is blank and the substrate class comes from prep's verdict, not the customer's claim

workflow.description: Check the current capability register - cyanide clearance, segregation, ventilation, training classes - against what the job might demand
workflow.artifact: capability register citation for this job
workflow.gate: the register is dated, carries its verify-jurisdiction note, and the job's candidate chemistry classes all fall inside it

workflow.action: Assemble the document base for candidate products
workflow.description: Collect TDS and SDS for every candidate bath and confirm family identity and compatibility from the documents
workflow.gate: every shortlisted product has TDS and SDS on file; undocumented candidates are struck

workflow.action: Fix the bath role architecture for the job
workflow.description: Decide which of strike, build and color roles this job uses and which tank fills each
workflow.gate: every layer the job needs has a named role and no role is silently merged into another without doctrine cover

workflow.action: Screen the gold families against the brief
workflow.description: Read the benchmark rows against the brief's wear, color, substrate, geometry and gate answers to produce the candidate family per role
workflow.gate: every accepted or rejected family cites a benchmark cell with a source tag, not a preference

workflow.description: Check whether the job's finish, substrate or hardness demand belongs to the dry-coating class before any wet commitment
workflow.gate: any out-of-scope verdict carries its reason and referral; no PVD-class job proceeds wet

workflow.action: Match the stack to the substrate class
workflow.description: Apply the substrate-to-stack map: barriers, strike doctrine, family compatibility for the verified class
workflow.gate: no displacement-prone substrate routes into gold without strike and live entry, and every barrier has a stated reason

workflow.action: Match the deposit class to the wear promise
workflow.description: Map the promised wear class to deposit class and thickness class, or trigger the downgrade/decline conversation
workflow.gate: promise, deposit class and thickness class agree, and marking-term thresholds are flagged verify-jurisdiction rather than recited

workflow.description: Turn the hue target into a route on the installed line and name the retained standard the result answers to
workflow.artifact: color plan with named retained standard
workflow.gate: the target tone is achievable on a qualified product and the karat-claim consequence is noted

workflow.description: Raise nickel-release, marking-term, food-contact and allergy-routing flags against the proposed stack and sales language
workflow.gate: every flag row is answered with a stack change, a wording change or a dated verify-jurisdiction note - none left open

workflow.action: Qualify any unproven bath on scrap
workflow.description: Run make-up per TDS and judge witness coupons against the retained standards before commitment
workflow.gate: no customer piece is scheduled into a bath lacking a current qualification record

workflow.description: Record product-per-role, stack row, claim flags, qualification references and rejection rationale, and open the bath-log header
workflow.artifact: committed selection record with bath-log header
workflow.gate: the record cites the TDS for every operating specific and hands process execution an unambiguous stack

priority_rationale: The frame nodes - brief, capability gate and TDS doctrine - come first because every family judgment, matching decision and record is only as sound as the job definition, the lawful envelope and the document discipline beneath it; the family and mechanism nodes then load the knowledge the matching nodes consume; and the matching, compliance and qualification nodes must all precede the decision record, which is deliberately last because committing an unqualified, unflagged or unmatched selection is the failure mode this entire KB exists to prevent.

dominance_rules.rule: The lawful capability envelope dominates every family preference
dominance_rules.rationale: running chemistry the premises may not hold risks lives, licenses and the business in a way no job value offsets
dominance_rules.trigger: any selection whose candidate chemistry class is outside or near the edge of the capability register
dominance_rules.action: strike the candidate, select inside the envelope, or defer the job until the envelope lawfully changes

dominance_rules.rule: The product TDS dominates memory, folklore and handbook generalities for every setpoint
dominance_rules.rationale: operating windows differ by product and formulation; remembered or generic numbers applied to the wrong product age baths and ruin work invisibly
dominance_rules.trigger: any operating specific about to be written, quoted or taught
dominance_rules.action: cite the specific product's TDS or say the number is unknown; handbook ranges appear only labeled as handbook-class context

dominance_rules.rule: Substrate physics dominates schedule and preference
dominance_rules.rationale: displacement smut and bath poisoning from a wrong-route substrate destroy both the piece and the tank economics at once
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to shortcut a strike, barrier or activation step in the stack row
dominance_rules.action: hold the doctrine route or refuse the job; no deadline buys a bare-steel-to-gold path

dominance_rules.rule: Compliance class dominates stack performance and cost
dominance_rules.rationale: a brighter or cheaper stack that fails its nickel-release or marking class is a liability wearing a nice finish
dominance_rules.trigger: a compliance flag conflicting with the preferred stack or claim wording
dominance_rules.action: change the stack or the wording to satisfy the class; escalate to human legal sign-off where the claim matters commercially

dominance_rules.rationale: brittle deposit classes crack at bends by published characteristic, and no bath quality or execution skill repeals that
dominance_rules.trigger: forming or resizing intent anywhere in the brief meeting a hardened-class candidate
dominance_rules.action: disqualify brittle classes and re-sequence the flow or re-select the family; disclose the wear trade of the ductile alternative

dominance_rules.rule: The qualification gate dominates the calendar
dominance_rules.rationale: an unproven bath's failure lands on a customer piece and the shop's name, which costs more than any missed date
dominance_rules.trigger: deadline pressure to run an unqualified or reformulated product
dominance_rules.action: hold the gate: qualified alternative, moved date, or declined job, with the reason told honestly

dominance_rules.rule: Honest class labeling dominates the sale
dominance_rules.rationale: plated goods misrepresented as solid, or flash sold as wear plate, is the trade's core ethical failure and eventually its most expensive one
dominance_rules.trigger: any claim word or wear promise exceeding the selected deposit and thickness class
dominance_rules.action: align the claim to the class or upgrade the selection to match the claim; the mismatch never ships

dominance_rules.rationale: a family that cannot physically reach the geometry produces bald recesses no operator skill fully rescues
dominance_rules.trigger: coverage-critical geometry meeting a poor-throw family candidate
dominance_rules.action: route to a better-throwing family or the electroless front-end, and leave current-distribution rescue attempts to the process bench only after the family is right

dominance_rules.rationale: self-compounded gold chemistry removes the TDS, the SDS, the supplier's liability and the shop's safety case in one stroke
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to formulate, blend or 'stretch' bath chemistry outside a product's TDS
dominance_rules.action: refuse; the selection space is purchased commercial products used per their documents, always

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read prep's verified substrate class before shortlisting any family
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a full re-selection and possible bath contamination when the 'brass' medal turns out to be zinc die-cast after the stack was chosen

anti_rework_rules.rule: Check the capability register before quoting any hue or wear class
anti_rework_rules.prevents: walking back a promise the line was never licensed or equipped to keep, after the customer has planned around it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the role map before choosing or buying any product
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a build bath pressed into strike duty because the tank count was decided by what arrived in the box

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put the TDS and SDS on file before the product is ordered, not after
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an undocumented tank on the line and a capability-gate reclassification after the chemistry is already wet

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the wear class before choosing the color route
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-choosing the color coat when a thickness change re-stacks the build it was tuned over

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the compliance flag sheet before the selection record is committed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: strip-and-restack of finished goods when a nickel-release or marking flag surfaces at the point of sale

anti_rework_rules.rule: Qualify on scrap before any customer metal enters a new or changed bath
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the worst rework in the trade - a customer piece as the failed trial coupon

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ask the route-out question at the brief, not after the first bad attempt
anti_rework_rules.prevents: gold and bench-days burned approximating a dry-coating finish the wet line was never going to match

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the rejection rationale into the record at commit time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the next selector re-litigating the same dead-end families from scratch on the account's reorder

iteration_protocol.trigger: a qualification coupon fails color, adhesion or coverage against the retained standards
iteration_protocol.action: stop the commitment, update the family screening and shortlist from the coupon evidence, and re-qualify or re-select before any customer scheduling

iteration_protocol.trigger: prep reports a different substrate class than the brief assumed
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the stack matching and support-class choices for the verified class and re-check the claim flags before work resumes

iteration_protocol.trigger: regulatory movement touches nickel release, marking terms or any market the trade book sells into
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the flag sheet across standing selections and templates, and re-verify jurisdiction notes with new dates

iteration_protocol.trigger: the shop's capability envelope changes - license gained or lost, premises, ventilation or staffing
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the capability register, recompute which families are selectable, and revisit tank sizing for the new envelope

iteration_protocol.trigger: a supplier discontinues or reformulates a qualified product
iteration_protocol.action: treat the successor as a new product: full qualification, benchmark update, and record amendments for affected standing selections

iteration_protocol.trigger: quality's defect map clusters failures on a family-to-job matching rather than bath health
iteration_protocol.action: revisit the benchmark cells and matching rows implicated, feeding the field evidence back before the same match repeats

iteration_protocol.trigger: trade accounts report color drift across reorders against retained standards
iteration_protocol.action: re-examine the color route and mechanism assumptions for the affected line and re-anchor the retained standard set

iteration_protocol.trigger: sustained job-mix or gold-price movement re-ranks the shop's tank sizing choices
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the sizing decision from the trailing mix and mortality logs, resizing or retiring tanks deliberately rather than by drift
